page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.24xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 3072.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 32.0 GB of RAM per physical core. Local storage consists of a 2850 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 75 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The instance achieved a multi-core stress-ng CPU score of 92868.95 and a Passmark CPU score of 74908.92, both placing in the top 25% tier. Memory bandwidth is also highly rated, with read-only small block cached bandwidth reaching 5008.9 GB/sec and large block uncached write bandwidth at 121.62 GB/sec. Single-core performance remains in the average tier, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 1589.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1891.98.

With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and local NVMe storage, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, and enterprise applications. It demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, scoring 29638.46 on Passmark database benchmarks and processing 88.2 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. The high resource density of 3.0 TB of RAM relative to 96 vCPUs offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive in-memory datasets, though the single-core performance profile suggests it is less optimized for purely single-threaded computational tasks.
